biography: Tuca Antoniazi, a name synonymous with Brazilian motorsport's vibrant future, didn't grow up karting like most racers. Instead, his path began on the dusty backroads of his family's coffee plantation in Minas Gerais. At 12, he was already tearing around in an old pickup truck, mastering the art of controlling a sliding vehicle on loose surfaces. It wasn't until a local hill climb event, where he stunned seasoned competitors with his raw talent, that racing became a serious pursuit. He entered the Hot Car Competicoes program, immediately turning heads with his fearless driving. After winning the Stock Car Light championship in 2021 with Hot Car New Gen, Antoniazi graduated to the main Stock Car Pro Series, where he currently competes with Hot Car Competicoes. While yet to clinch a title, his audacious overtakes and relentless pursuit of the podium have made him a fan favorite and a driver to watch.
drivingStyle: Antoniazi's driving style is best described as 'controlled aggression.' He's known for late-braking maneuvers and daring overtakes, often threading the needle in situations where others wouldn't dare. While this occasionally leads to collisions, it also results in spectacular passes and unexpected victories. He's still refining his tire management skills, sometimes pushing too hard early in a stint, but his raw speed and ability to extract maximum performance from the car are undeniable. Under pressure, Antoniazi tends to thrive, elevating his game when the stakes are highest.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Viana
rivalries.reason: A veteran of the sport, Viana publicly criticized Antoniazi's aggressive driving style, leading to several on-track clashes and heated exchanges in the media.

rivalries.name: Isabela Flores
rivalries.reason: Flores and Antoniazi are both young talents vying for the same opportunities. Their battles on track are always intense, fueled by mutual respect and a fierce desire to be the best.

rivalries.name: Joao Costa
rivalries.reason: Costa and Antoniazi are former teammates who had a falling out after a controversial incident during a race where Antoniazi overtook Costa.

quirks: Always wears a small, hand-carved wooden charm depicting Saint Christopher, the patron saint of travelers, inside his racing suit.
Listens to a specific playlist of Brazilian funk music before every race to get pumped up.
Refuses to eat anything green on race days, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: Racing isn't just about speed; it's about heart. You gotta want it more than anyone else, and be willing to risk everything to get it.
careerHighlight: Winning the 2021 Stock Car Light championship after a season-long battle, securing his promotion to the premier Stock Car Pro Series.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the penultimate race of the 2022 season after a mechanical failure, costing him a potential podium finish.
